summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect, wholly-owned special-purpose financing subsidiary, RCRED Craftsman Administrator, LLC, as seller, amended and restated its Master Repurchase Agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as buyer and repo agent, dated January 30, 2026. The November 3, 2026 amendment primarily revises the income payment waterfall by eliminating a requirement for certain payments to reduce the outstanding purchase price, with related changes. No purchase price, stake, premium or closing date is disclosed. This is a routine warehouse financing amendment, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and margin-maintenance terms.
